# Routine Streaks 1.2.4

## Improvements

- Weekly target routines now show their weekly progress in widgets, such as `2/3 this week`, so they are easier to distinguish from daily task completion.
- Routine widgets now show each routine's schedule type at a glance: `Weekdays`, `Weekly`, or `Interval`.
- Scriptable widget exports now include per-routine progress and schedule type metadata, keeping the iPhone widget display-only while using the exported `data.json` as the source of truth.

## Notes

- After updating, regenerate the Scriptable widget code from the plugin settings to show the new progress and schedule type badges on iPhone widgets.
